title: Pool Villas for Rent in Phuket Under ฿80,000 a Month
excerpt: We list 151 rentals with a private pool, and 31 of them cost less than ฿80,000 a month. Where they are, what the budget gets you, and why none of them are in Bang Tao.
author: Islander Home Team
content:
A private pool is what most people picture when they imagine living in Phuket. It is also more affordable than many expect, provided you are willing to live a little further from the island’s most famous beaches.

As of late October 2026, we list 151 homes for rent with a private pool. 31 of them cost less than ฿80,000 a month. The figures below cover those 31 properties.

The numbers

  • Median rent: ฿60,000 a month
  • Cheapest: ฿40,000 a month
  • Bedrooms: Most have two (15) or three (10) bedrooms; four have four bedrooms, and one has a single bedroom
  • Pet-friendly: 6 of the 31 listings state that pets are welcome

Chalong accounts for more than half of these properties. Seventeen of the thirty-one are located here, many around Soi Palai, Hideaway Valley and the roads between Wat Chalong and Rawai. Most are two- or three-bedroom villas in small developments.

None are in Bang Tao. On our list, pool villas near Bang Tao Beach and Laguna have a median rent of ฿180,000 a month. If your budget is under ฿80,000, consider looking further south and inland instead.

A few examples from the current list

  • A one-bedroom private pool villa in Rawai: ฿45,000 a month
  • A two-bedroom pool villa near the sea, Chalong: ฿45,000 a month
  • A three-bedroom pool villa where small pets are welcome, Chalong: ฿52,000 a month
  • A pool villa with a German kitchen, Kathu: ฿60,000 a month
  • A boho-style pool villa with a rooftop terrace, Saiyuan 4, Rawai: ฿70,000 a month
  • A three-bedroom pool villa with a Big Buddha view, Hideaway Valley: ฿75,000 a month

What to ask about the pool

  • Who cleans it, and how often? Weekly pool maintenance is often included in the rent, but not always.
  • The size. At this budget, many pools are plunge pools measuring just a few metres. Ask for the exact dimensions if you plan to swim laps.
  • Electricity. The pool pump runs every day. Ask whether electricity is charged at the government rate.
  • Fencing. If you have young children, check whether the pool can be fenced off or covered.
